note: Evil Mode slice 4 (design Part 9, Part 10a sections 1-3, Part 7 section 11, Part 5 section 5). Talents, flaws, the thirty-six lines with the job tags each matches, ranks and wages, the rules' numbers, the scenes' lines, and the people: the sixteen Founders and Kanto's twelve. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested. Text is never in the save, only ids. Slice 17 adds Johto and Hoenn (twelve each, Part 10a sections 4 and 5) and the thirteen who come only when something has happened (Part 10b section 6; the fourteenth is a note on the board, not a person). Every person has a quest shape (Part 10c section 4).

talents.name: Voice
talents.refuses: No. I'll ask anyone anything. Not this. Send me to talk to someone instead.
talents.lead: I'll need to know what I'm allowed to promise. I'd rather promise less and keep it.

talents.name: Hands
talents.missing: Nobody here can pick a lock.
talents.refuses: Not that one. Give me a lock, any lock. Not that.
talents.lead: Do I have to do the talking? I can't do the talking.

talents.name: Eyes
talents.refuses: I've looked at it. I'm not going. You'd not go either, if you'd looked.
talents.lead: I'll tell you now: I'm going to see things about the other two that I won't pass on. You'll have to be all right with that.

talents.name: Nerve
talents.refuses: No. Dock me. I'm not doing it.
talents.lead: Who are my two? …Good. They'll do.

talents.name: Books
talents.refuses: I've costed it. It costs more than you think, and I'm the cost. No.
talents.lead: There's a squad float. ₽200 a day. I've costed it. It's on your desk.

talents.name: Wheels
talents.refuses: I'll drive anyone anywhere. Not to that.
talents.lead: A squad. So I've to come back with all of them. Every time. …All right.

talents.name: Heart
talents.refuses: No, love. Not that one. Ask me anything else today.
talents.lead: If I think a job's wrong for one of them, I'm going to say so. To you. Before, not after.

flaws.name: Talks
flaws.note: Two pages. The last line's "Sorry for the length."

flaws.name: Drinks
flaws.note: "I'd only have let you down at a worse time."

flaws.name: Doubts
flaws.note: "I think you know why. I think you've known longer than I have."

flaws.name: Skims
flaws.note: An envelope. It's the money. All of it, back to the first.

flaws.name: Freezes
flaws.note: No note. Their kit, healed, in its balls, on the pillow.

flaws.name: Loves someone on the other side
flaws.note: "We're going to try the other side of the water. Don't look for us. Or do. I'd not mind."

flaws.name: Proud
flaws.note: "I'd have stayed for less than you think."

flaws.name: Kind
flaws.note: "The Pen's unlocked. I'm not sorry. Look after them."

tags.fightLocal: Outplay against a local: they've one Pokémon and weren't expecting a match

lines.text: Won't lie to a local's face.
Won't work a racket on old people.
Won't go in a house at night.
Won't wear the uniform in my own town.
Won't frighten anyone smaller than me.
Won't do it if I can't tell my mum.
Won't drive away from one of ours.
Won't fight anyone who's not ready.
Won't tell you where I'm from.
Won't take a bribe to anyone.
Won't work with the other lot.
Won't work against the other lot.
Won't be paid for a kindness.
Won't stand by while the kid's hurt.
Won't cheat at a fair fight.
Won't keep a secret from the Roster.
Won't. Ask me when it comes up.

ranks.title: Specialist
ranks.needs: A room their talent fits (the base comes later)

ranks.title: Officer
ranks.needs: A disagreement with the Boss, spoken, at Night (the Night comes later)

ranks.title: Executive
ranks.needs: Loyalty 8 or more; an Officer for a district at least

text.refusalTitle: In the yard, in front of the squad.
text.swapNone: Nobody free whose line is clear.
text.withdrawn: {name}: "…Thanks, Boss. I'd expected to be made."
text.swapped: {name} watches who went. {who} will hear about it at supper.
text.insisted: The Boss says it again. {name} takes off the armband, folds it and puts it on the bonnet of the van. "I thought you might. I hoped you wouldn't. They're different things." The kit's on the Mess table that evening, in its ball, with a note: "It's the team's. Give it to somebody who'll be good to it."
text.noBunk: There's no bunk. {cap} is the most this base sleeps.
text.deckEmpty: Nobody's come. That's everyone in this region who was ever going to.
text.nobodyToday: Nobody at the notice board today.

turnedKind.young: {name} goes home. Their mother writes to say thank you.
turnedKind.old: {name} nods, and says they'll be about. They will be.

text.turnedRude: {name} goes, and the Town hears how. Regard −1.
text.promoteTitle: In the Office. The Boss calls them in.
text.letGoneKind: {name} goes with a month's wage and the armband in a pocket. Warm, as a local.
text.leftLoyalty: {name} was gone by morning. A note on the bunk: {note}
text.wontTitle: What this team, as it stands, won't do.
text.noteFaye: A note on the board, unsigned: "Ask them about {name}."

people.name: Otis Blackthorn
people.why: I did eleven years on a door for a man who never learned my name. You asked it first thing.
people.quest: To be asked his opinion, once, before a decision's made, and have it change the decision

people.name: Faye
people.why: I'm small. People think that means I'll do the things small people get made to do. I'd like to see them try.
people.quest: Her surname

people.name: Tobi
people.why: I can get into anything. I've not yet found anything worth being in.
people.quest: A thing worth being in

people.name: Lux
people.why: I see things. I've been sacked from four jobs for mentioning them.
people.quest: To see something and have it acted on

people.name: Ngozi Olatunji
people.why: The cannery shut. I can do a payroll in my head.
people.quest: The cannery's back wages: ₽2,400, owed to forty people, by somebody

people.name: Tomasz Wieczorek
people.why: My brother's in. He says there's dental.
people.quest: His brother: who's in what, exactly?

people.name: Hortense Nnamdi
people.why: I was a ward sister. They retired me. I'm not retired.
people.quest: A ward

people.name: Vikram Ramanathan
people.why: I got expelled for something I did do.
people.quest: His sister's school fees; and what he did

people.name: Sioned Prys
people.why: I've been a union rep for twenty years. Nobody's got a union for this.
people.quest: A contract. For the Roster. With the Boss's signature on it

people.name: Kwabena Mensah
people.why: I came second in the regional. Four times.
people.quest: One thing nobody can say he came second at

people.name: Beatriz Carvalho
people.why: I'm eighteen.
people.quest: Where she's from

people.name: Old Obadiah Gribble
people.why: Three Bosses. You'll be the fourth. Is there a pension?
people.quest: To sign something. Once. And for it to have been right

people.name: Chidi Nwosu
people.why: I want to see what's behind the door. Any door.
people.quest: The door

people.name: Rahel Tesfaye
people.why: You leaned on my dad's shop. I wanted to see who'd send people to do that.
people.quest: Her father's shop, and whether she tells him where she's been

people.name: Jun-seo Baek
people.why: I drove for the last lot. I know every back road in the region.
people.quest: Sundays: where he goes; who he sees there

people.name: Halima Yusufzai
people.why: My daughter joined you. I've come to keep an eye on her.
people.lineText: Won't do it if I can't tell my daughter.
people.quest: Her daughter

people.name: Arlo Finnerty
people.why: I dealt cards at the Game Corner. I know what the house takes. I'd like to work somewhere that admits it.
people.quest: The Game Corner's real ledger, which he copied and hid

people.name: Mirela Dragan
people.why: I cleaned Silph for twenty years. Eleven floors. Nobody locks a door against the cleaner.
people.quest: What she saw on the eleventh floor

people.name: Dov Halpern
people.why: Bike gang. Cycling Road. It broke up when Koko got a job. I miss having people.
people.quest: Getting the gang back together, for one ride

people.name: Nanami Ueda
people.why: I nursed at the Pokémon Tower. The ones nobody came back for. I'd like to nurse something that gets better.
people.quest: Mr. Fuji, who's getting old, and who'll run the House after

people.name: Garrick Stowe
people.why: Dockhand. Vermilion. The Anne comes in, we unload, we're not told what. I'd like to be told what.
people.lineText: Won't work against the other lot. (His brother's in Rocket.)
people.quest: His brother

people.name: Pilar Quintero
people.why: I failed the Pokémon League entrance twice. On the written.
people.quest: The written

people.name: Efua Addai
people.why: I'm a locksmith. Saffron. Every door in that city's got four locks since they came. I fitted half.
people.quest: Going back to Saffron

people.name: Walther Brandt
people.why: I taught at the Celadon school till they made the department store bigger. I've a pension. I've nothing to do with it.
people.quest: A classroom

people.name: Soo-ah Lim
people.why: I'm eighteen in March.
people.quest: March

people.name: Ignatius Okafor
people.why: I was a Rocket Grunt for six years. I never got a name. I had a number. I'd like to be Ignatius somewhere.
people.quest: His number: who else had numbers; where they are

people.name: Catriona Baird
people.why: Safari Zone warden's deputy. He's lost his teeth and I'm doing both jobs for one wage.
people.quest: The warden's teeth

people.name: Yevgeny Sokolov
people.why: I built the Power Plant. They shut it and left it to the birds. I'd like to build something that stays open.
people.quest: The Power Plant, lit again

people.name: Hinata Mori
people.why: I ran the Radio Tower's switchboard. Then they came, the first time, and I put their calls through, because I was frightened. I'd like to not be that again.
people.quest: The Tower, when they come the second time

people.name: Barnaby Osei
people.why: Charcoal burner. Forty years in Ilex. I've a Farfetch'd that minds better than my lad did.
people.quest: His lad, who went to Goldenrod and doesn't write

people.name: Tsering Dolma
people.why: I was a Kimono Girl's understudy. Six years. I never danced the piece.
people.quest: Dancing the piece. Once. In the Hall will do

people.name: Eamon Kerrigan
people.why: Lighthouse keeper's mate, Olivine. The lamp's a Pokémon. When she's ill, we're dark. Somebody should've had a second plan.
people.quest: A second plan: a real lamp, for when Amphy can't

people.name: Sachiko Yamane
people.why: I've sold RageCandyBars at Mahogany for fifty years, over a cellar I never asked about. I'm asking now.
people.quest: The cellar

people.name: Cosmin Lupu
people.why: I dive. Whirl Islands. There's something down there and the old men say don't. I've stopped listening to old men.
people.lineText: Won't touch a shrine. He means it. He dives round it.
people.quest: What's down there. He doesn't touch it. He looks

people.name: Adaeze Nwachukwu
people.why: Pharmacist. Cianwood. I've made the medicine for every sick Pokémon west of Olivine and I've never left the island.
people.quest: Leaving the island

people.name: Ruairí Tanaka
people.why: Bug-catching contest. Came first. They said my Scyther was a ringer. It wasn't. I'd like to be somewhere that takes my word.
people.quest: The contest, entered again, in front of the same judge

people.name: Mwajuma Hassan
people.why: I ran the Goldenrod underground: the stalls, the barber, the herb man. Then the rents went up. All at once. Somebody wanted us out.
people.quest: Who wanted them out

people.name: Leif Aronsen
people.why: I pulled the Tin Tower's bell rope. A boy's job. I did it till I was fifty. Nobody ever told me what it called.
people.quest: What it called. He finds out. He's glad he didn't know sooner

people.name: Quyen Phan
people.why: Ruins of Alph. Research assistant. I solved the fourth panel and my supervisor published it. I've got the fifth. I'm not telling him.
people.quest: The fifth panel, under her own name

people.name: Dermot Ashworth
people.why: I drove the Magnet Train. Goldenrod to Saffron, there and back. I've never once got off at the other end.
people.quest: Getting off at the other end. It's the Crossing

people.name: Keala Makani
people.why: Aqua wanted me because I can sail. Magma wanted me because my dad's a miner. I'd like to be wanted for something I chose.
people.lineText: Won't work with the other lot. Either lot.
people.quest: Something she chose

people.name: Rohan Deshmukh
people.why: Devon. Accounts. I've seen what they pay for sea-floor rights and I've seen who they don't pay.
people.lineText: Won't take a bribe to anyone.
people.quest: Who they don't pay

people.name: Imelda Castellanos
people.why: I've run the Pretty Petal shop since before either of them had a uniform. Both lots buy flowers. For different funerals.
people.quest: Two nephews: one's Aqua, one's Magma, and it's her birthday in District 4

people.name: Tavita Leota
people.why: I surf. Brawly taught me. He says I've no patience. He's right. I'm working on it. This is me working on it.
people.quest: Patience: a rematch with Brawly, which she has to wait a whole region for

people.name: Greta Lindqvist
people.why: Weather Institute. I read the instruments. Lately they've been wrong, and they're not wrong, the weather is.
people.quest: What's wrong with the weather. She knows. She wants somebody to believe her

people.name: Babajide Afolabi
people.why: Ferryman's son. Mr. Briney's getting on. Somebody's got to run Peeko's route and it's not going to be either of them.
people.quest: The route, kept: a holding, his, at the Crossing

people.name: Miyu Kanzaki
people.why: My brother went up Mt. Pyre to leave flowers and joined Magma on the way down. I'm going to get him back.
people.lineText: Won't tell you how old I am. The card tells you.
people.quest: Her brother

people.name: Orsolya Varga
people.why: Glassblower. Route 113. I make flutes from volcanic ash. Magma wants the mountain to do more of what makes the ash. I don't want it that much.
people.quest: A flute, for the Hero. She makes one for every child who passes

people.name: Declan Ferreira
people.why: Trick House. I was the Trick Master's apprentice. He says I've no imagination. I built the Combine a door once that opened onto another door.
people.quest: A room the Trick Master can't get out of

people.name: Lakshmi Iyer
people.why: I taught at the Rustboro school with Roxanne. She marks fairly. I'd like to see how you mark.
people.quest: Marking the Boss. She does. Each district

people.name: Finlay Okoro
people.why: Diver. Sootopolis-born. You can only get in under water, so everyone who lives there's somebody who decided to. I've decided to leave.
people.quest: Going home. By the front. On a boat. With something to show

people.name: Zainab Qureshi
people.why: Space Center. Launch technician. Fifty-odd launches. Magma want the fuel. I've got the keys. I've not slept properly since they found that out.
people.quest: One night's sleep. It needs the Space Center safe

people.name: Gideon Asante
people.why: You did the bank. I was a teller at the bank. I've no job. I thought: they've got money.
people.lineText: Won't go back in a bank.
people.quest: A job that isn't a bank

people.name: Ama Kowalczyk
people.why: My uncle threw your lot out of his shop. He's been telling everyone. I thought you'd look different.
people.quest: Whether they look different

people.name: Sam Okonkwo
people.why: I've always wanted to.
people.lineText: Won't. Ask me when it comes up.
people.quest: They don't say

people.name: Dorothea Lake
people.why: You gave somebody's Pokémon back. Nobody does that. I wanted to see who does that.
people.quest: To see who does that

people.name: Hal Brightman
people.why: I'm the Leader's second junior. She said you were worth a look. She said: tell them I said 'a look,' not more.
people.quest: More than a look

people.name: Ivo Marchetti
people.why: I was on the other side of that. I saw how yours got their hurt out first. Ours didn't.
people.lineText: Won't work against the other lot. The old lot.
people.quest: The old lot, and whether they're eating

people.name: Effie Marsh
people.why: My gran says you're the best thing to happen to this town since the bypass. I'm to make myself useful.
people.lineText: Won't do it if I can't tell my gran.
people.quest: Being useful

people.name: Cole Draper
people.why: I hear you're the ones to be scared of. I'm tired of being scared. I'd rather be standing behind it.
people.quest: Not being scared

people.name: Lottie Briggs
people.why: I heard you're broke. I'm cheap.
people.quest: Being paid

people.name: Matthias Rowe
people.why: I was on the crew that built it. You paid on the day. I've never been paid on the day.
people.quest: Being paid on the day, again

people.name: Nadia Ferrante
people.why: I saw your people beat that kid and then walk them to the Center. I'd like to know which half of that's the real one.
people.quest: Which half's the real one

people.name: Peter Hollis
people.why: I was a constable. I was told to drop your file. I'd like to know why I was told.
people.quest: Why he was told

people.name: Rosalind Teague
people.why: They say nobody ever leaves your lot. I'd like to be somewhere nobody leaves.
people.quest: Somewhere nobody leaves
